notes: חֲרוֹן אַף is rendered attributively as *fierce anger*, so rule 28 governs rather than rule 19's *of*; the chain's supplied *the* goes to the outer construct חֲרוֹן, since no article morpheme stands in it.

כָּל־רָאשֵׁי הָעָם is the arthrous case of rule 29: the ASV writes a *the* before *chiefs* and another before *people*, so nothing is fronted — the article takes the one standing before its own word and the construct takes the supplied one.
The waw of וְיָשֹׁב takes the ASV's purpose *that*, so no subordinator is added here (rules 14, 55).
